summary: Iteration 123 tested the two fixes picked by the user: (1) Rapid Fire notation engine (real powers/subscripts) and (2) load_guard crowd-vs-hiccup fix. Ran test_load_guard_sustained.py 3 more times: 3/3/3 pass every run, zero flakiness. Live `/api/health/load` returns the new `lag_sustained_ms` plus the existing fields (busy=false, inflight=1, sockets=0, open_files_limit=1,048,576). Load probe --users 100 against the public preview: 0 arena_busy (503) and 0 errors across all 7 endpoints. Load probe --users 200: still 0 arena_busy; the non-arena_busy 429/TimeoutError counts come from the preview ingress throttling at that concurrency (upstream, not the app) and busy=false right after. Index spans and stacked vertical-align spans observed on Math integrals (101 index spans + 29 stacked spans across 15 Math cards; screenshots show ∫₁ᵉ, ∫₀²π, ∫₀¹, ∫ₐᵇ with limits visibly stacked). Physics shows I₀, ω₀, I_avg rendered with subscripts as glyphs or typeset index (no X_L / I_rms as typed). English: 10/10 cards keep '___' blanks as underscores with 0 index spans created, 10/10 render as plain text nodes with no child spans; font = 20px Figtree-600 for prompt and 16px Figtree-600 for options; no rf-error, no page errors. Layout: at 320x568 scrollWidth==viewport=320; at 768x1024 scrollWidth==viewport=768; 2 tie whiteSpace spans measured at 320, 0 overflowing >1.7x line-height. N4 finish-early: rf-sum-correct+rf-sum-incorrect+rf-sum-skipped+rf-sum-timeout = 0+0+30+0 = 30 ✓; Review listed 30 rows with 0 code-like leaks across chosen/correct/explain/formula. No application code changed. No arena (/api/arena) touched. No TEST_ data created.
